**Sayan Dutta** in [his LinkedIn post](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7390673163854155776/) has clearly explained the practices done by Unified Mentor.

The Unified Mentor internship scheme operates as a training funnel targeting job seekers with promised remote stipends before demanding upfront confirmation fees.
